_meta.description: Locking device retention data and ISO 2320 prevailing torque values
references: ISO 2320:2008 — Prevailing-torque type steel hexagon nuts
ISO 16130:2015 — Test methods for locking effectiveness under vibration
VDI 2230:2015 Part 1 Annex B — Locking and securing elements
Jiang & Hess (2003) — Self-loosening classification with locking devices

prevailing_torque_nut.label: Prevailing-torque nut (deformed thread / nylon insert)
prevailing_torque_nut.notes: ISO 2320 minimum prevailing torques. Nylon insert limited to ≤120°C

all_metal_prevailing_nut.label: All-metal prevailing-torque nut (Stover / oval / tri-dent)
all_metal_prevailing_nut.notes: Re-usable up to 5 cycles before prevailing torque degrades >30 %

lock_washer_spring.label: Spring (split) lock washer
lock_washer_spring.notes: Limited effectiveness per DIN 65151 vibration tests; not recommended for safety-critical joints. Provides some Stage I embedding resistance.

nord_lock_washer.label: Nord-Lock® wedge-locking washer pair
nord_lock_washer.notes: Cam angle > helix angle ensures self-locking under vibration. slip_onset_factor raised (harder to slip) compared to bare bearing surface.

belleville_spring_washer.label: Belleville (disc) spring washer
belleville_spring_washer.notes: Effective against embedding losses (Stage I). High spring rate maintains preload under thermal cycling. Less effective against rotational Stage II.

double_nut.label: Double nut (jam nut / lock nut configuration)
double_nut.notes: Requires correct tightening sequence: jam nut first, primary nut second. Effective against Stage II rotational loosening when properly installed. Per CLAUDE.md: BOTH nuts must have their own ThreadContact in the MSD model.

chemical_locking.label: Thread-locking compound (e.g. Loctite 243 / 270)
chemical_locking.notes: Values for medium-strength (Loctite 243-equivalent). High-strength (270) approaches permanent. slip_onset_factor raised to 1.0 (classical Coulomb) because chemical adhesion eliminates micro-slip. Temperature limit typically 150°C.

iso_2320_minimum_prevailing_torques._note: ISO 2320:2008 Table 1 minimum prevailing torques for property class 8/10 nuts [N·m]

junker_din65151_effectiveness_class._note: Qualitative Junker DIN 65151 test effectiveness ratings
junker_din65151_effectiveness_class.belleville_spring_washer: C  — retains >70 % F₀ at 1000 cycles (Stage I only)
